test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Hindi was declared as the official language of Union under Article _______ of Indian Constitution.
solution:
The correct answer is __**343**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The official language of the Union** is** Hindi in the Devanagari script**, according to **Article 343(1) of the Indian Constitution**.
 
• **Article 343(2)** stated that English would continue to be used in official Union activities for a period of 15 years from the date of the constitution's inception, i.e. until January 25, 1965.
 
• Again, **article 343(3) **empowered the parliament to pass laws to ensure that English would continue to be spoken after January 25, 1965.
 
• Both Houses of Parliament passed the Official Language Resolution on January 18, 1968.
 
• This Resolution was approved to create a comprehensive programme for the Union of India to expand the use of the Hindu language for official purposes.
 
• As a result, the Official Languages Act of 1963 was passed, allowing English to be used after the stated date of 1965.
 
• According to the Act, resolutions, regulations, general instructions, notices, press communiqués, administrative and other reports, licences, tenders, and other documents must be written in both English and Hindi. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The number of Anglo-Indians who may be nominated to the State Legislative Assemblies is left to the Governor's discretion under **Article 333 of the Constitution.**
 
• **Article 334 **established a time limit for these reservations, however, it is periodically extended by the parliament.
 
• In making appointments to services and posts in connection with the operations of the Union or a State, **Article 335 **states that the claims of members of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes shall be taken into account, commensurate with the maintenance of administrative efficiency.
